lighting.type: abundant natural daylight with soft shadows

prompts.positive: A bright and airy Scandinavian modern living and dining room, with light wood plank flooring, warm off-white painted walls, and one accent wall in terracotta orange. A teal velvet sofa with neutral throw pillows, a simple light wood coffee table, and a round light wood dining table with spindle-back chairs. Abundant natural light streaming through large windows and a glass door leading to a garden. Potted green plants, minimalist framed artwork, and woven blinds. Clean lines, comfortable, inviting atmosphere.
prompts.negative: Cluttered, dark, gloomy, messy, overly ornate, cold lighting, saturated colors, outdated furniture, poor composition.
